verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is an LLM gateway and proxy whose configuration (routing, fallbacks, guardrails, MCP access) could plausibly be versioned, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no versioning, review, or rollback of automations or configs. Traffic mirroring, logging and call_id tracking are adjacent features that do not deliver version history or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
